stem: Which medical investigation is typically arranged to check for genetic conditions associated with autism during the assessment process?

options.text: CGH microarray and Fragile X testing.

explanation: The doctor lists CGH microarray and Fragile X as standard investigations performed during the assessment.
rationale: The text mentions two specific tests used to screen for chromosomal and genetic markers.

optionExplanations.A: The source mentions that there is no imaging test to confirm an autism diagnosis.
optionExplanations.B: The doctor lists CGH microarray and Fragile X as standard investigations performed during the assessment.
optionExplanations.C: An EEG is not mentioned in the text as part of the standard initial investigation battery for autism.
optionExplanations.D: While allergies are checked as part of history, skin prick tests are not listed as a core diagnostic investigation for autism.
